long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Dubrovnik, Kisić began earning money on fishing boats at nine and later qualified as a ship master and marine engineer. That experience joined practical seamanship with a lifelong connection to commercial fishing. He became proprietor of BUNACA, a Zaton business registered for marine fishing, passenger cruising and coastal transport.

Kisić moved from fishing into high-service Adriatic tourism, combining captaincy with ownership and direct responsibility for crews and guests. His operating approach centres on service, itinerary planning and the practical demands of life at sea. BUNACA remains active, with passenger excursions and charter work complementing its fishing roots.
